A '''tourmaline crystal''' was a rare kind of [[tasar crystal]] that had the ability to turn an individual [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and to imbue them with a specific [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] after several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of attunement. The tourmaline crystal was colored in various shades of blue, ranging from pale azure to deep indigo. The crystal had the ability to grant an individual the power of [[Force empathy/Legends|empathy]].<ref name="J15" />
